chunks: Rijal al-Kashshi: Hamduwayh, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Abu Hashim Dawud ibn al-Qasim al-Ja'fari, from Abu Ja'far ibn al-Rida (peace be upon them), who said:
I asked him about Yunus, so he said: The client of the family of Yaqtin? I said: Yes. He said to me: May Allah have mercy on him, he was a righteous servant.

key_terms.آلِ يَقْطِينَ: The family of Yaqtin, a specific clan or family group
key_terms.عَبْدًا صَالِحًا: A righteous servant, a term of praise for piety and devotion
key_terms.مَوْلَى: Client or follower, indicating a social or patronage relationship
key_terms.يُونُس: Yunus ibn Abd al-Rahman, a prominent companion of the Imams

ai.seo_question: Who was Yunus ibn Abd al-Rahman and what was his relationship to the Imams?
ai.summary: This brief narration from Rijal al-Kashshi confirms Yunus ibn Abd al-Rahman’s identity as the mawla of the prominent Banu Yaqtin family, a lineage known for its close association with the Imams. By describing him as an 'abd salih' (righteous servant), the Imam validates his reliability in hadith transmission, a key criterion in Shia rijal science for establishing the authenticity of narrated traditions.
